label: flock-blocked
argv:
import fcntl,sys
with open(sys.argv[1],"a+b") as stream:
 try:
  fcntl.flock(stream,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
  print("acquired")
 except BlockingIOError:
  print("blocked")
